summary: Backend-only Office document conversion runtime testing completed. Security validations working correctly (8/10 tests passed). LibreOffice conversion fails in restricted chroot environment but works on host system.

critical_bugs.issue: LibreOffice crashes with RuntimeException during initialization in chroot environment. Return code -6 (SIGABRT). Error: 'com::sun::star::uno::RuntimeException' in SvtSysLocaleOptions initialization.
critical_bugs.impact: DOCX and XLSX to PDF conversion fails in production chroot environment. Conversion works correctly on host system without chroot restrictions.
critical_bugs.details: LibreOffice 7.4.7.2 cannot initialize in the heavily restricted chroot with UID 65534, seccomp filters, and resource limits. All configuration files (main.xcd, etc.) are present in runtime. Issue appears to be related to system access restrictions during LibreOffice initialization.
critical_bugs.workaround: LibreOffice conversion works on host system. May need to adjust chroot environment or seccomp filters to allow necessary system calls.

working_features: Runtime security setup (chroot, UID 65534, passwd/group files) - WORKING
LibreOffice binary and dependencies copied to runtime - WORKING

action_item_for_main_agent: LibreOffice conversion framework is correctly implemented with proper security validations (file size, signatures, macros, zipbombs all working). However, LibreOffice 7.4.7.2 cannot initialize in the restricted chroot environment (crashes with SIGABRT during SvtSysLocaleOptions initialization). This is a runtime environment issue, not a code issue. Options: (1) Investigate LibreOffice requirements in chroot and adjust seccomp filters, (2) Use alternative PDF conversion library, (3) Run LibreOffice in less restricted environment with other security measures. All security validations are working correctly and will reject malicious files as designed.

technical_details.error_details: Return code: -6 (SIGABRT). Stack trace shows crash in com::sun::star::uno::RuntimeException during SvtSysLocaleOptions/SvtSysLocale initialization. All required configuration files (main.xcd, etc.) are present in /app/backend/.office_runtime/usr/lib/libreoffice/share/.registry/
